book.name: Mako
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Mako

content: Mabholu ghabhajopali kuhuma kwa akahokolo
Lichobha limu Mafalisayo na bhabhola bhangi bha Shelia bhabhahumila ku Yelusalemu bhakapiti kumbona Yesu.
Bhakabhaweni bhabhulwa bhangi bhaka Yesu bhakakula chilebhi kwa mabhoku ghabhu panga kuchamba ngati moipalakila.
Ndandi Mafalisayo na Bhayahude bhokapi bhakamulaki namaa mabholu ghabhajopali kwa akahokolu bhabhu, ngachebhakula chindu panga kuchambaki ngati mokupalakila.

Kabheti ngachebhakula chindu chokapi kuhuma paligulio panga kugholo hoti ngati mokupalakila na mitetu jabho. Jikabhi kabheti mitetu jengi jebhajopali kutumbu pamwandi ngati ntundu wa kugholo ikombi, sufulia na yombu ya shaba.

Bhela Mafalisayo na bhabhola bhangi bha Shelia bhakandaluki Yesu, “Bho, maghambu kiki bhabhulwa bhaku ngachebhajengale mitetu ja akahokolu bhito, nambu bhakula chilebhi kwa mabhoku ghanga kuchambaki ngati mokupalakila?”
Yesu akabhayangiki, “Mwanganya mulibhona mbi wichu na koni ngachembi wichu! Mlota Isaya akapwaghiki chakaka panani jinu mabhanganya paakalembiki,

content.text: ‘Chapanga apwagha, bhandu abhabha, bhanumbali kwa malobhi pela,
nambu mu mitima jabhu, bhabhi kutali na nepani.
maghambu bhaghabhola malaghalaki ghaghahuma kwa bhandu,

content: “Mwanganya mwileka amuli yaka Chapanga na kukamuliki malaghalaki gha bhandu.”
Yesu akajendali kupwagha, “Mwanganya kwa malangu ghinu mjikana amuli jaka Chapanga nahuli mpata kujengale majopale ghinu!
Ndandi Musa akapwaghiki, ‘Untopila atati waku na mabhu waku,’ na ‘Mundu jokapi joantondo atati waki na mabhu waki, apalika akomakikaje.’
Nambu mwanganya mbola, ‘Ngati mundu abhi na chindu cheaweza kunjangati atati waki au mabhu waki, nambu apwagha kubha, chindu che hechi nde Kolubani,’ yani cha kumpeke nhupu Chapanga,
bhela ngacheapalika kabheti kunjangati atati waki au mabhu waki.
Bhenibhela nde momulikani Lilobhi laka Chapanga kwa ndandi ja mabholu ghamulibhekile. Kabheti muhenga mambu ghamahele ngati ganihaga.”
Hindu yeyuntenda mundu abya muhakau
Yesu akalilohiki kabheti lipogha la bhandu lela, na kubhapwaghila, “Nyowanyaje mabhokape, na mmanyaje.
Nga chindu cheakula mundu chechiweza kuntenda mundu abya nhwakau. Nambu chechipita mumtima jaka mundu nde chechuntenda mundu abya nhwakau.
Joabhi na makutu gha kujowanela, na ajowanaje!”
Paalilekiki lipogha la bhandu na kujingi munyumba, bhabhulwa bhaki bhakundaluki ndandi ja mabholu gha ulenganesu ghonighola.
Na jombi akabhapwaghile, “Bho, hata mwanganya le ngachemmanye? Bho, ngachemmanyi kubha chindu chechunjingi mundu kuhuma kunja ngachechiweza kuntenda mundu abya muhakau,
maghambu ngachechunjingi mumtima, nambu mulutumbo, na ujomukelu waki kupita kunja kulikelo?” Kwa kupwagha bhenibhela Yesu akaigholwi ilebhi yokapi.
Akajendali kupwagha, “Mambu ghaghapita nkati jaka mundu, nde ghaghuntenda mundu abya muhakau.
Kwa ndandi kuhuma nkati, mumtima waka mundu, ghapita maholalelu ghaliyaha, ukemi,
wihi, kukoma, ugone, utokulelu uhakau, milomu, wime, kukoloha, malobhi gha utane na wihu, matondu, ing'omu na ung'ang'a.
Mahakau ghanihagha ghokapi ghahuma mumtima waka mundu, na ghombi nde ghaghuntenda mundu abya muhakau.”
Uhobhalelu waka mabhu jumu
Bhela Yesu akabhokiki panipala, akapiti ku inchi ja ku Tilo. Konihoku akajingi mu nyumba jimu na ngachepai mundu amanyaje, nambu ngacheaweziki kulihiya.
Nambu mbomba jumu joakabhi na mwali waki joakabhi na lijobhi, akajowini malobhi ghaka Yesu, akahikiki na kulileke palongi ja magholu ghaki.
Mbomba hoju akabhi Mgiliki, mwenei wa ku Silofainike. Akundobhiki Yesu amboha kamwali waki lijobhi.
Yesu akumpwaghile, “Ubhalekaje bhana bhatupila hoti, kwa ndandi nga wichu kutola chilebhi cha bhana na kujenda kuipeke nakawa.”
Nambu mabhu jola akapwaghike, “Chakaka, Bambo, hata nakawa yeibhi pahi ja meza ikula mahighalilu gha ilebhi ya bhana.”
Yesu akumpwaghile, “Kwa ndandi ja lilobhi leniheli, ubhujaje kunyumba jaku. Lijobhi lumbokiki mwali waku!”
Bhela akapiti kunyumba jaki, akunketani mwana aghoni pachitanda na lijobhi lumbokike.
Yesu andamiha mpuli ngajowa
Yesu akabhokiki ku inchi ja ku Tilo, akapetili ku Sidoni, akahikiki ku bahali ja Galilaya kwa kupetela inchi ja ku Dekapoli.
Bhela bhakundeti mpuli, najombi akabhi ngajowa, bhakunjopiki ambekila mabhoku nahuli andamihaje.
Yesu akumbohiki mundu jola pa lipogha la bhandu na akunjingi ngonji mu makutu ghaka mundu jola, akahuni imata mu ngonji yaki na kunkamu mundu jola pa lulimi.
Panihapa Yesu akalingali kunani kumahunde kwaka Chapanga, akapomwi kwa makili, na kumpwaghila, “Efata,” ndandi jaki, “Uhoghukaje.”
Palapala mundu jola akatumbwi kujowana wichu, na chifungu cha lulimi lwaki chakabhopwiki, na kulonge wichu.
Yesu akabhakanaki ngabhampwaghi mundu jokapi jola lilobhi lenihele. Nambu ngati moakabhakanakili, nde mobhajendalili kutangaza lilobhi lenihele.
Bhandu bhakakangichi namaa na kupwagha, “Atehi ghokapi wichu. Abhatenda hata akangajowa kujowana, na akabhapuli kulongela!”
